Replace the boolean panel-availability hook with a lane-class tag hook. ## Background The proof-surface seam design (dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §3 fixes the three-part seam with probe-verified surface claims, §4 gives each field its name, kind, range, default-naming constant, mechanism and route-observation obligation, §5 records the decisions (D1 direct removal, D2 lane split, D3 opaque pin, D4 default naming, D5 public reporters, D6 source-level convention amendments), §6 enumerates the post-processing deletions, and §8 scopes the tasks. The follow-on migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) supplies the shared field-kind, mechanism and test conventions. ## Success Criteria - [hard] REQ-01: PlePanelLane and #[doc(hidden)] fn simd_ple_panel_lane() -> Option replace has_simd_ple_panel_base(), with the Fp

override under #[cfg(not(verify_lean))] exactly as the existing accelerator hooks carry it. - [hard] REQ-02: Dispatch behaviour is unchanged (the driver gates on lane presence); the extraction surface is unchanged (the seam design's probe AS3 verifies the target state); the workspace CI contract passes.
title: Introduce the PLE panel lane hook
